method: 32 games x 35 turns per cell; police Perception vs a thief whose hints are all-truthful vs all-lying on identical seeds; error = Manhattan(belief argmax, true cell); mass = belief on true cell. Parser (domain/belief.py) is parity-locked: applies to both twins.

profiled_liar_0.1.why: a known liar lying HELPS us: inverted weights read lies as signal
